Applied on its own when you switch to this profile, and kept on its own when you switch away, so each profile comes back to its own panel.

A page of the panel or a saved template can come up by itself. A page holds the panel on it and does not cycle away; a template replaces the arrangement. When several apply, a Bluetooth device wins, then the charger, then Wi‑Fi, then the time of day; when none does, the panel goes back to the profile’s own. A Wi‑Fi network is chosen by being on it, and its name needs the location permission. Changes made while a template holds are kept in it, the way a profile keeps its own.
